Reachable keeps the content of a declarative shadow root

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{hidden_content: "Reachable"}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<div><template shadowrootmode=\"open\"><p>shadow body</p></template><span>light body</span></div>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
